_about: Methanol (1) + Methyl myristate (2): total pressures against temperature, 493-543 K, at set liquid compositions. Rows: temperature in K, liquid mole fraction of methanol, pressure in kPa, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record.

source.citation: Y. Shimoyama, Y. Iwai, B. S. Jin, T. Hirayama, Y. Arai, Measurement and correlation of vapor liquid equilibria for methanol + methyl laurate and methanol + methyl myristate systems near critical temperature of methanol, Fluid Phase Equilib. 257 (2007) 217-222
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 3. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. No isotherm of the set has its own pure-component pressures, so the fit uses the vapour pressures of the component records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
